# Design hub: app, web, Design System

One page to move between the three design layers of Pema. App canvas: 82 screens (A1 … K3). Web canvases: 384 screens (211 old-web ids WA … WI, 173 Next.js-only ids WJ … WL). Design System: 64 component pages, one token file.

| Layer | Start here | Specs | Canvas file |
|---|---|---|---|
| App (KMP, mobile) | [App](#1-app-82) | `screens/<ID>.md` | `Pema App redesign canvas/Pema App.dc.html` |
| Web, old (Clinic Web, Finance, Patient Mobile) | [Web](#2-web-384) | `web/screens/<ID>.md` | [Pema Web.dc.html](../Pema%20Web%20redesign%20canvas/Pema%20Web.dc.html) |
| Web, Next.js-only (agent admin, care agent, sign-in, shell, templates) | [Web](#2-web-384) | `web/screens/<ID>.md` | [Pema Web (Next.js).dc.html](../Pema%20Web%20redesign%20canvas/Pema%20Web%20%28Next.js%29.dc.html) |
| Design System | [Design System](#3-design-system) | `design-system/components/<block>.md` | blocks: [Pema Web blocks.dc.html](../Pema%20Web%20redesign%20canvas/Pema%20Web%20blocks.dc.html) |

How the ids relate:

- An app id (A1 … K3) and a web id (WA1 … WL19) are two designs of the same thing when the web id lists the app id in its `App canvas` column (`app_canvas` in `web/inventory.json`; `—` = no app counterpart, never a filter). The App table below carries the reverse map, so the lookup works in both directions.
- 197 of 384 web ids cite at least one app id; 78 of 82 app ids are cited by at least one web id.
- Ids are frozen. Never renumber; new ids are appended to the end of their group.
- The old web is the reference for behaviour, the app canvas for look. The Next.js-only ids (WJ, WK, WL) have no old-web or app original.

### 2.2 Patient Mobile web (WI): served by KMP/Zalo

Group WI (Patient Mobile web, 42 ids). Owner decision 2026-10-05: not a Next.js target; the designs stay as reference for the KMP app and Zalo.

**Revisit when the clinic has a Zalo OA.** Revisit when the clinic has a Zalo OA: a lightweight web page opened from Zalo (patient identity from the Zalo user) is the only case where a patient web would be rebuilt. Until then status stays "served by KMP/Zalo".

## 3. Design System

Source in the repo: `design-system/` (64 component pages, one `tokens.json`). Both web canvases and the blocks canvas point to it. Publishing to claude.ai/design is deferred.

| What | File |
|---|---|
| Overview, change rule, commands | [design-system/README.md](../design-system/README.md) |
| Tokens (single source of values) | [design-system/tokens.json](../design-system/tokens.json) |
| Colour roles, light and dark, contrast | [design-system/colors.md](../design-system/colors.md) |
| Type scale | [design-system/typography.md](../design-system/typography.md) |
| Spacing, radius, elevation, frame sizes | [design-system/spacing-radius-elevation.md](../design-system/spacing-radius-elevation.md) |
| Components: block, `src/ui` component, KMP `core:ui` composable (64 pages) | [design-system/components/INDEX.md](../design-system/components/INDEX.md) |
| Web canvas blocks and how often screens use them | [web/BLOCKS.md](web/BLOCKS.md) |
| App canvas blocks to Compose | [BLOCKS.md](BLOCKS.md) |

## 4. Keeping the canvases in step

- **Canonical skill: `pema-web-design`** (`.claude/skills/pema-web-design/SKILL.md`). The Next.js front end is the product, so one skill covers the web canvases, the specs, the change log (`web-design-changes.md`) and this hub.
- `pema-web-to-canvas` is app-only (the app canvas from web changes, log `web-changes.md`); `pema-canvas-to-kmp-compose` builds the app from the app canvas.

## Regenerate

```
node .claude/skills/pema-canvas-to-kmp-compose/scripts/design-specs.cjs            # app specs and this file
node .claude/skills/pema-canvas-to-kmp-compose/scripts/design-specs.cjs --check
node .claude/skills/pema-web-design/scripts/unify-index.cjs --check             # links, counts, every WI row mapped
```
